description.zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，保证在不同请求间唯一，大小写敏感、不超过 64 个 ASCII 字符。
description.en: A client token to ensure request idempotence. Generate a unique token for each request. The token must be case-sensitive and up to 64 ASCII characters long.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun polardb restart-db-node-zonal --db-node-id pi-0000000000000 --db-cluster-id pc-00000000000000 --client-token 6000170000591aed949d0f54a343f1a4233c1e7d1c5c000000 --region cn-hangzhou
